title: DayCounter
description: Shows the current day in the world
body:
![requires fabric api](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/requires/fabric-api_vector.svg)  ![requires cloth config api](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3.3.1/assets/cozy/requires/cloth-config-api_vector.svg)  ![requires fabric launge kotlin](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3.3.1/assets/cozy/requires/fabric-language-kotlin_vector.svg)  ![built with gradle](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3.3.1/assets/cozy-minimal/built-with/gradle_vector.svg) ![works with Mod Menu](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3.3.1/assets/cozy-minimal/requires/mod-menu_vector.svg)

**EN:** This mod adds a day counter at the top of the screen, highly customizable!

**RU:** Этот мод добавляет счёчик дней в верху экрана, очень кастомизированный!
